cases.sentence: Поднеси рог к своим губам, как орел налетит враг на народ ___.
cases.explain: The phrase 'народ Господа' (God's people) uses the genitive case for possession.

cases.sentence: Израиль взывает ко мне, «О Бог наш, мы признаем ___!»
cases.explain: The transitive verb признаем (acknowledge) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Из своего серебра и золота люди делают для себя ___ себе на погибель.
cases.explain: The transitive verb делают (make) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я отверг твоего идола, ___. Мой гнев воспылал на этот народ.
cases.explain: In direct address of a city name, the nominative case is used.
The transitive verb опожнут (reap) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Израиль поглощен, теперь он среди ___ как негодный сосуд.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.
The transitive verb приобретал (acquired) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Израиль забыл своего создателя и построил ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb построил (built) governs the accusative case.

reading.ru: Поднеси рог к своим губам, как орел налетит враг на народ Господа, потому что народ нарушил мой завет и приступил мой закон.
reading.question: Why will the enemy come against God's people?
options: They broke God's covenant and rebelled against His law
reading.correct: They broke God's covenant and rebelled against His law
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that the enemy will come because the people broke the covenant and rebelled against the law.

reading.ru: Они взывают ко мне, «О Бог наш, мы признаем тебя!» Но Израиль отверг добро, враг будет преследовать его.
reading.question: What is the contradiction in this passage?
options: Israel claims to know God but has rejected good and will be pursued by enemies
They call to God but refuse to listen
They acknowledge God but worship idols
They praise God but follow their own ways
reading.correct: Israel claims to know God but has rejected good and will be pursued by enemies
reading.explain: Israel calls out we acknowledge you, but then the text states that Israel has rejected good and the enemy will pursue them.

reading.ru: Из своего серебра и золота люди делают для себя идолов себе на погибель.
reading.question: To what purpose do they make idols from silver and gold?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states they make idols 'себе на погибель' — for themselves to their own destruction.

reading.ru: Люди сеют ветер, опожнут бурю. У стебля пшеницы не будет колоса, и зерно не даст муки.
reading.question: What will be the consequences of their evil actions?
options: They will reap destruction and their crops will produce nothing
They will gain wealth and prosperity
Their enemies will flee from them
reading.correct: They will reap destruction and their crops will produce nothing
reading.explain: The text uses the metaphor that they sow wind and reap whirlwind, and that the wheat will produce no grain and no flour.

reading.ru: Израиль забыл своего создателя и построил дворцы. Иудея укрепила многие города, но я пошлю огонь на их города, который пожрет их дворцы.
reading.question: What will happen to the cities and palaces they built?
options: They will be repaired and strengthened
They will be traded to other nations
reading.explain: God says He will send fire on their cities, which will devour their fortresses.

reading.ru: Хотя Ефрем построил много жертвенников для приношений за грех, они стали жертвенниками греха.
reading.question: What happened to the altars Ephraim built?
options: They became altars for sin instead of for atonement
They became more holy and pure
reading.correct: They became altars for sin instead of for atonement
reading.explain: Ironically, the altars built for sin offerings became altars of sin.
